edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both quotes state that Benny Caldera Jr. is 40 years old. The sources are different news organizations (The Hill and CBS News).

edges.sentence: On 2026-09-30, CBS News reported “The agency said it received credible information on Tuesday that 40-year-old Benny Caldera Jr. was planning the attack for Thursday, Oct. 1.”; on 2026-10-01, The Hill reported “The department arrested Benny Caldera Jr., 40, in the San Antonio area early Wednesday morning in connection with the incident.”.
